profile.name: Custom Project Clean Code, Security & Performance Profile

sonarjs/no-all-duplicated-branches.description: Conditional operations must not return or execute identical logic across all branches (S1871, S3923).

sonarjs/no-identical-expressions.description: Identical expressions on both sides of a binary operator must be eliminated (S1764).

sonarjs/no-unthrown-error.description: Error or Exception instances created must be thrown or returned, not left floating (S3984).

sonarjs/no-dead-store.description: Unused assignments and dead store variables must be removed (S1854).

sonarjs/no-unused-vars.description: Variables, parameters, or imports declared but never used must be removed (S1481).

sonarjs/no-duplicate-string.description: Strings duplicated 3+ times must be extracted into dedicated constants (S1192).

sonarjs/no-hardcoded-credentials.description: Hardcoded passwords, API keys, tokens, and secrets are strictly forbidden (S2068 / OWASP A07).

sonarjs/sql-injection-risk.description: Raw SQL string concatenation is strictly prohibited (S2077 / OWASP A03).

sonarjs/no-insecure-randomness.description: Insecure random generators must not be used for tokens/crypto (S2245 / OWASP A02).

sonarjs/path-traversal-prevention.description: Unsanitized user inputs in file paths must be prevented (CWE-22 / OWASP A01).

customRules.name: No BuildContext Across Async Gaps Without Mounted Guard
customRules.description: In Flutter, using BuildContext across async gaps without `if (!context.mounted) return;` causes crashes when navigating away.

customRules.name: No Blocking Main Thread / Startup Lifecycle Over-Initialization
customRules.description: Prohibit heavy, sequential, or blocking initializations in app entry points (`main.dart`, `Program.cs`, `App.tsx`) before the first frame renders.

customRules.name: Offload Heavy Computations from Flutter Main Isolate
customRules.description: In Flutter/Dart, CPU-intensive parsing or crypto must use `compute()` or `Isolate.run()` to prevent UI jank.

customRules.name: Mandatory Disposal of Flutter Controllers & Subscriptions
customRules.description: All `AnimationController`, `TextEditingController`, `ScrollController`, and `StreamSubscription` instances must be cleanly disposed in `dispose()`.

customRules.name: Secure Storage for Auth Tokens & Credentials
customRules.description: In Flutter/Mobile, tokens must be stored in encrypted secure storage (`flutter_secure_storage`), not plain `SharedPreferences`.

customRules.name: No Raw Exceptions In User Feedback (CWE-209 / OWASP)
customRules.description: Never expose raw error objects or stack traces directly in SnackBars, Dialogs, Alerts, or Toasts.

customRules.name: Proper Error Catching & Logging
customRules.description: Catch blocks must not be empty or silently swallow exceptions.

customRules.name: Avoid Sync-Over-Async Blocking (.Result / .Wait())
customRules.description: In .NET / C#, calling `.Result` or `.Wait()` on Tasks is prohibited to prevent thread starvation and deadlocks.

customRules.name: Exhaustive Dependencies in React Hooks
customRules.description: All reactive values referenced inside `useEffect`, `useCallback`, or `useMemo` must be in the dependency array.

customRules.name: No Array Index as React Key in Dynamic Lists
customRules.description: Using array indices as keys in dynamic list rendering is prohibited. Use unique entity IDs.

customRules.name: Zero Hardcoded Color Hex Values
customRules.description: Hardcoded hex colors are prohibited. Must use centralized theme tokens or design system constants.

customRules.name: Mandatory Image Alt Descriptions
customRules.description: All image components must provide a descriptive alt attribute (WCAG 2.1 AA).

customRules.name: Secure External Links
customRules.description: All external links with target='_blank' must include rel='noopener noreferrer'.
